title: Tooling: batch registered research source-pin reads
head: 2c2b583848ffe3c169b3ce18b7e6a982b4281aa4
body:
Registered package validation launches two Git processes per source row plus a catalogue read. This change streams exact blobs through one `git cat-file --batch -z` process while retaining blob IDs, SHA256, live-input comparisons, originating-card checks and replay selection. On identical synthetic inventories built from committed source bytes, five alternating timing pairs measured a 130-row median of 1.282 s → 0.032 s on Python 3.12 and 1.109 s → 0.027 s on Python 3.14; Git processes fall from 261 to one. This measures the validation stage only, with no mathematical or kappa claim.

- Task: `replay-runtime`, refined to source validation; selector nonce `56f0ac74ea193d0ed3d48475463fca2a`, priority revision 2. Base: current main at session start, `1f327c6f3e3a35271c5c141d381b540bab8ad005`.
- Evidence: `research/research-package-pin-batching/` contains the task card, exact predecessor pins, all timing samples/environment, a standalone parity/mutation harness and an explicit bounded replay hook. Blob bytes are streamed one at a time; there is no persistent cache.
- Validation: the registered Python 3.12 replay passes with 12 failure controls and six positive-control groups; all 20 onboarding/assignment tests pass on Python 3.12; the optimized Python 3.14 benchmark/controls pass; selected-result bindings and whitespace checks pass. Controls include final-row/duplicate substitutions, live-input invalidation, binary/NUL/empty/newline framing, early child cleanup, truncated replies and a nonzero exit after the final blob. Timings are diagnostic, while parity, rejection and exact process counts are enforced.
- Scope: no supplier cold replay or full multiplication proof was attempted. The selected frontier, frozen evidence and mathematical replay commands are unchanged. Malformed provenance entries naming Git trees are now explicitly rejected. Local host: macOS arm64/Git 2.53.0; hosted Linux results remain separate.
- Overlap: final full refresh covered 728 open PRs and 238 discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings. PR1298 (`e76026571dbfa7299bf474b941c9abeb5bd556b3`) handles Windows codecs and process timeout cleanup in the same helper; these changes are complementary. PR1461 (`1a092583b989051a089cdba68b52cedf36a8d78e`), PR1559 (`c4f8af1dcf9fc2317c893b6b250007ded5ef879f`) and PR1372 (`9b00c9f93a05351fb1a712dc201539de30f8738b`) address different stages. Exact coverage and pins are in TASK.json.
- Credit: Douglas Colkitt's manifest/source-pin/live-vs-provenance design is retained. Maxime Fleury's audit following Antoine Olivier's replay informed portability triage. Prepared by Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0; no subagents.

Reproduce from a full-history checkout:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/research-package-pin-batching
```

Discussion claim and completion: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1585

Open next question: repeat the fixed benchmark on the Linux/Python 3.12 registered runner; the deterministic process reduction and host-dependent time should be reported separately.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
